test_title: PYST 35: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

Many restaurants __serving compliment__ bread with the meal.
solution:
The correct answer is: '**serve complimentary**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Many restaurants**" is the subject of the sentence. This subject is plural because it refers to more than one restaurant.</
